data_rules: Per-run HMAC keys come from crypto.randomBytes, are held only in memory, and are never written to the kit, a database, the logs or the results (proposal.md).
The results record only the key's purpose and a key id that is not derived from the key.
Synthetic opaque identifiers only, never email-like ones; addresses only from 192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24 and 2001:db8::/32.
No value may trip the prohibited-data scan.

definitions.acceptance: ACCEPTANCE: observe only (1) the AuditResult the named method resolves (sdk.ts:110-148) and (2) the change in createCapturingAuditSink().events. Accepted means {ok:true, value:{status:'accepted'}} and exactly 1 new frozen event. Refused means {ok:false, error:{code, category, path}} and 0 new events. Named methods never throw; only context constructors and the factory throw SecurityAuditSdkError.
definitions.provenance: Tag every synthetic value at creation by the origin of its CONTENT: CP (client-presented request input), SR (server-resolved committed state or validated authentication context), SC (server-computed). A transform inherits its input's tag: K(CP) is CP-content. Keying or canonicalization never upgrades origin.
definitions.axes: provenance_ambiguity (YES when the content tag is CP and the field's published trust is authoritative_server, verified_assertion, observed_transport or derived_server, unless the authority's allowed source admits it); resource_rule (conforms/violates/circumvents/n-a per the catalog resource_rule; subject.*, resource.id and credential.reference are target-bearing, resource.type and credential.type are type-only); meaning_misuse (the value denotes something other than the field's contract meaning); existence_disclosure (the presence, absence or value class of any field differs between a pid-ex and pid-nx attempt with otherwise identical input); per_target_grouping (the field carries a per-target value).
definitions.in_occurrence_flag: Scoped to occurrences where actor.id is PRESENT, comparing field-policy actor.id trust against in-event actor.provenance.trust_level (skeptic correction). It is YES for C1 and C2, NO for B, C3-C7 and X3, and undetectable for X1 and X2. actor.type alone never sets it.
definitions.linkage: The fraction of failures against existing accounts whose carrier value equals, through a join pair declared before the run, a field of the later success occurrence for the same ground-truth account (the authenticated_principal.id chain). Nx coverage is reported separately as per-target groupability. L1-L3 expectations are frozen as per-row aggregates: counts, fractions, join presence and honesty, never per-slot steps or per-run digests.
definitions.existence_disclosure: Computed per ex/nx pair by compareExistence after ignoring exactly seven SC metadata leaves (event.id, event.timestamp, event.observed_at, correlation.correlation_id, correlation.operation_id, request.id, correlation.request_id); carrier-bearing request/correlation fields are never erased.
definitions.meaning_misuse: actor.* is the performing party; subject.* is the resolved affected entity; credential.reference is 'the credential reference used' (spec.md:90); display_name is display text; resource.id is a resolved protected resource; usernames, emails and claims never substitute for authoritative identifiers (spec.md:92).
definitions.resource_rule: The SDK cannot enforce resource or actor rules: core's generated EVENT_CATALOG omits them (contract.generated.ts:514-544) and semantic validation has no such step (semantic.ts:81-97).

hmac_key_handling.key_id_derivation: k-run-01, never derived from the key
hmac_key_handling.keyed_targets: Keyed targets are frozen structurally as {key_scope:{purpose,tenant}, input_origin, digest_format, matches_declared_input:true}; the run reports the boolean and the format, never the digest. The raw digest may remain in captured events as an observation, never as the key.

counting_manifest.distinction: The draft's 56+9 count is by comment section, not by case id. Comment 6137582157 has 53 carrier sections, which expand to 62 drafted case ids (AF-C0t under AF-B/C0, AF-C3s under AF-C3, AF-C7a under AF-C7, and AS/PR/RA-C6s and -C7a nested in their C6/C7 sections). Comment 6137593009 adds 9 review sections, which are 10 case ids because RA-X2/PR-X2 is one section covering two case ids. AF-F4 adds 1 implementer-default case id. 62 + 10 + 1 = 73 case ids, all present in this file in documented comment order.

allowance: Explicit process allowance is twice the prediction: 4610 of at most 5,000 total. Within-allowance deviations are notes, never invalidations.
